week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Patchy fog before 8am. Mostly sunny. High near 52, with temperatures falling to around 48 in the afternoon. East southeast wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 56. South southeast wind 1 to 5 mph.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm, then rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 50. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 46.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Rain and snow likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 46.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 42. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: A chance of snow before 11am, then a slight chance of rain and snow between 11am and 5pm. Partly sunny, with a high near 43.

discussion.key_messages: - Patchy fog development is possible for fog-prone areas across the Cache Valley and Wasatch Back overnight into Sunday morning. - After a couple dry and mild couple days, another weather system impacts the region with widespread rain and mountain snow on Tuesday into early Wednesday. - A second storm will bring another round of valley rain and mountain snow Thursday into Friday; this storm has potential to bring lower snow levels, but low confidence at this time.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 5–20 in. over the next 7 days (middle 9 in.), and they disagree a lot. About 2 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 4 in. for the week.
